name: PayloadProfile
title: Payload profile
description: One profile the documents of a member's own FHIR endpoint (`connectionType` `hl7-fhir-rest`) follow, in the registry document in FHIR form. The extension repeats once per profile, and such an endpoint carries at least one. FHIR R4 `Endpoint.payloadMimeType` names a serialisation, and no element of FHIR R4 `Endpoint` names a profile.
